{{One source|date=September 2026}}
'''Louis Walter Davies''' (1923-2001) was an Australian [[Radiophysics|radiophysicist]]. He was an elected [[Lists of fellows of the IEEE|fellow of the Institution of Electrical and Electronic Engineers]], the [[Engineers Australia|Institution of Engineers]] and the [[List of fellows of the Australian Academy of Science|Australian Academy of Science]]. He was an appointed [[Order of Australia|Officer of the Order of Australia]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Louis Walter Davies 1923–2001 {{!}} Australian Academy of Science |url=https://science.org.au/our-focus/history-australian-science/fellows-biographical-memoirs/louis-walter-davies-1923-2001 |access-date=2026-08-12 |website=science.org.au}}</ref>
